items.title: Fazbear Orientation Program
items.summary: The Fazbear Orientation Program is a virtual simulation used to train new Fazbear Entertainment employees; it serves as the main setting of Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2.

items.title: The Office (FNaF2)
items.summary: The Office is a location within Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and is the central location of Five Nights at Freddy's 2.  As in the first, third, and seventh games, the Office is the only room that the player inhabits.

items.title: Right Hall (UCN)
items.summary: The Right Hall returns in Ultimate Custom Night as CAM 02.  It takes the form of a long hallway directly to the right of the Office.

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 3 (Mobile)
items.summary: The mobile port of Five Nights at Freddy's 3 was first released for Android on March 6, 2015 and for iOS on March 11, 2015.  This port costs $2.

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 3 (Demo)
items.summary: The demo version of Five Nights at Freddy's 3 was released exclusively for YouTuber let's players on March 2, 2015.

items.title: Paperpals
items.summary: Paperpals, individually Paper Buddy, Paper Bonnie, and Paper Freddy, are a trio of paper plates that serve as recurring props and recurring "characters" in the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise.

items.summary: Party Time Chica is a mascot suit that debuts in Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic as a suit that the Mimic wears.
